content:
Maya: Heads-up: scheduling a short maintenance window for edge-fabric microcode flip + BMC sanity checks in apac-west1. Target start 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z.

Sam: ETA length?

Maya: ~40-60m total, rolling across 4 racks (cohorts). We'll do staggered drains to keep latency SLOs.

Leo: Which tenants are on those racks? any priority customers we should pin?

Maya: Rack mapping -> cohort A: low-traffic batch jobs; B: mixed; C: 2 enterprise tenants (alpha, beta); D: infra services + small tenants.

Anika: For C (alpha/beta) we should offer canary fallback to eu region and pre-warm KV cache there. Ops will notify support to offer migration guidance.

Sam: Agree. Plan: cordon -> drain (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data <node>) -> runfw (microcode flip) -> BMC soft-reset -> uncordon. Verify pod distribution and kv cache hit after uncordon.

Maya: Adding exact commands in runbook. We'll run two-node overlap (leave 1 GPU per rack active) to keep steady capacity.

Maya: Runbook snippet:```bash
for n in ${COHORT_NODES}; do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
  ssh $n sudo firmware-update --stage microcode
  ssh $n sudo bmc-reset soft
  sleep 45s
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```

Leo: How are we handling prefix/KV cache reseeding? we lost cache last time and saw a 2x token cost spike.

Maya: We'll use kv-seed job with staggered start before each uncordon. Re-seed policy: top-500 prefixes over 10m window.

Anika: Cost note: expected ephemeral token cost bump ~6-8% during the 2-hour window for affected tenants. Send cost heads-up to finance?

Sam: I'll put quickline in #finance with expected delta and recovery timeline.

ops-bot: scheduled window created: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z (apac-west1). Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/edge-micro-bmc-2026-04-02

Maya: Canary plan: start with cohort A (non-prod) -> cohort D -> cohort B -> cohort C. If error rate >1% for 10m, abort and rollback microcode.

Leo: What metrics to watch? latency p95, token cost per minute, error_rate (grpc 5xx), and KV cache hit ratio.

Anika: I'll set up a temporary dashboard and alert: alert if p95 increases >30% or kv hit ratio drops >20%.

Sam: Support comms: draft: "Planned maintenance in apac-west1 on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Short rolling reboots for firmware updates; we expect minor latency impact for affected traffic; failover available to eu and us regions. Contact support if you need pre-migration." Approve?

Maya: LGTM. Add explicit note about stateful jobs: ephemeral-disk scrub will run, long-running training jobs will be preempted.

Leo: We'll give 4h notice to tenants with scheduled training.

Maya: Post-checklist: verify kernel msgdumps, bmc sensors, nvme SMART, and confirm no unexpected pod evictions. Also capture perf snapshots (perf top 30s) for the first cohort after uncordon.

Anika: I'll own post-check and summary report.

Sam: I'll own tenant notifications + finance note.

Maya: Ops-run lead. On-call rotation: Sam -> Leo -> Maya for the window.

ops-bot: incident playbook link attached: https://playbooks.redwood/edge-fw-rollback

Leo: One more: ensure our autoscaler cooldowns are extended (+15m) so we don't overscale during drains.

Maya: Good catch — updating autoscaler policy now and will push commit.

Anika: 👍  

Sam: thanks all. I'll post a reminder 1h before and 15m before.

Maya: If anything changes, update this thread.
